pick_word.subtitle: Run from the Bear! Don't trip!

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which ghost did you like best?
Have you ever seen a ghost?
options: Yes, and I was so scared!

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Indeed, I am a ghost, and I have come to you tonight to bring you a warning!

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: The life you have chosen for yourself will bring you no happiness.

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Tonight, you will be visited by three spirits: The ghosts of Winter Holidays Past, Present, and Future...

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Heed their words, child. Mend your ways, or you will spend your afterlife enduring the same agonizing torments I do.

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: My time here is at an end... Farewell.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: What is it? Do you have a question?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just one... Was that three spirits including you or, like, four spirits total?

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Oh, that's a good question. Let me see... Carry the one, divide by Pi, and then...

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: What do you think?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Um... Four total?
Obadiah Prince begins to dissolve into thin air.

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Heed... Their... Warnings... Child...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What? The ghost of Obadiah Prince is gone...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe he was never even here...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe this was all just a terrible dream...

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Very good, child! Though you have the slack-jawed affect of a simpleton, you clearly possess some intelligence!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait... Is that a compliment?

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Part compliment, part insult... In my time, such a conversational stratagem was employed to endear oneself to the feeble-minded.

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: We called such a technique 'Ye Neg'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! Wait a minute... I'm not feeble-minded... And that's just a direct insult!
Tom hurls a screwdriver at Obadiah... It passes right through him!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh no! You... You really are a ghost!

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: I'm not a hallucination!!!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You could be... I remember this one time I ate day-old caviar and drank a pot of Indonesian palm civet coffee.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: When I finally got to sleep, I dreamt I was in line at the supermarket... And all of my credit cards were declined!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I was poor! Talk about a terrible nightmare!

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: You think that was a nightmare? Behold!
Obadiah kicks off his shoes to reveal hideous skeletal feet!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh no... Such unholy metatarsals!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But... If you're not a hallucination... That must mean you're a... Gulp... `Ghost!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But... If you're not a hallucination... That must mean you're a... Gulp... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ghost![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Tom, I'm here to inform you that there will be a Winter Holiday Party at `Prince Manor` this evening.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tom, I'm here to inform you that there will be a Winter Holiday Party at [color=#e23b3b][i]Prince Manor[/i][/color] this evening.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Black tie, I presume?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Indeed. But don't bother getting dressed up. You won't be attending.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?! Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Prince Industries is attempting to secure a lucrative merchandizing contract with the `Centerscore Comets` sports team.
nodes.text_bbcode: Prince Industries is attempting to secure a lucrative merchandizing contract with the [color=#e23b3b][i]Centerscore Comets[/i][/color] sports team.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But I love the Comets! I have to meet them!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Maybe so, but Prince Industries is all about success, and you... After your recent string of failures, are nothing more than a liability.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're telling me I can't go to a Holiday Party at my own house?!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I'm not 'telling' you anything, Tom. I believe what I just gave you was an `order.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not 'telling' you anything, Tom. I believe what I just gave you was an [color=#e23b3b][i]order.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: See you in the New Year, son. After I negotiate this deal, I think I may take an extended vacation somewhere tropical.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Ta ta.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Grr... Like I wanted to attend that stupid party anyway. I'm much too busy getting my revenge on Mallika.
Tom turns back toward the catapult... As he makes his final adjustments.
`KSPRANG!!!`
The catapult fires, striking Tom upside the head!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ow! That really... Really...
Tom falls over, unconscious...
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Nnh... My head is ringing like a... What happened? I must've gotten knocked out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What time is it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Huh? What's that sound? It almost sounds like... Rattling chains?!

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: OooOOOooohhh!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Who... Who goes there?!

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: OooOOOooohhh!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Show yourself! I'm warning you!

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Very well, Tom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What...?! Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: I am your great-great- grandfather, Obadiah Prince.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But... That's impossible! Obadiah Prince died a hundred and thirty years ago! If you were him, you would have to be a...
Obadiah rattles his chains menacingly.

nodes.prompt: If you were him, you would have to be a...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: If you were him, you would have to be a...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Yes. That's the one. What was it she did to you again?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: She pushed me into the ocean... And then laughed at me!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: And why?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because I insulted the waiter while we were on our date. And then she started dating the waiter! And then the waiter won the Flex-Games! And then...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Silence! You're life is unbelievably convoluted! Now then...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: There's more than one girl?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Frankly, Dad, there are a lot of ladies who don't understand how super-rich I am, and how that makes me super-cool by default.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But don't worry... Once my bizarre and overly-elaborate schemes lead to their humiliation, they'll all want to date me.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Hmm... Perhaps I've neglected an important discussion concerning relationships. Unfortunately, it will have to wait.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yes... We're done. Just step through that door.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What?! No! Your father drove away your mother by focusing `only` on money!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! No! Your father drove away your mother by focusing [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] on money!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe so... But he got rich! Look around you! This house is tiny! Have you seen the amazing mansion we live in now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: When visitors ask to visit the indoor pool, our Butler asks, 'Which one'?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Having money rules!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Tom, I'm not sure you're learning the appropriate lesson here...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever... We done?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Excellent. You have learned your first lesson well.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, I mean, seriously... My Dad just let my mother walk out on him like that!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That must've been humiliating!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He should've dropped what he was doing and gotten revenge!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No, Tom! Your father was poor, but your mother made him happy. When she left, no amount of money could fill the void in his heart.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Really...?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Sorry, dude, but that's the truth.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But that's so... Sad... Sniff..

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't think I can take any more of this... Sniff... Can we go now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey, wait a second... who are those people? Why do they look so familiar?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Because they're your parents.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But they're so... Young!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Shh... Listen!

nodes.speaker: Miriam Prince
nodes.text: Silas, where are you going?!

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: Where do you think? To work.

nodes.speaker: Miriam Prince
nodes.text: Work?! But it's the Winter Holiday!

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: So? Money doesn't care what day it is!

nodes.speaker: Miriam Prince
nodes.text: But I do! This is the day you're supposed to spend with family! What will little Tommy think when he finds out you've gone to work again?

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: Hopefully, Tom will learn the value of a dollar. It'll be the first step in ensuring he doesn't become a whining romantic like his bleeding heart mother.

nodes.speaker: Miriam Prince
nodes.text: Whining romantic?! That's the last straw, Silas! If you take one step out that door, you'll never see me again!

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: Are you asking me to choose between making money and my wife?

nodes.speaker: Miriam Prince
nodes.text: And what if I am?

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: Then that's no choice at all. Don't be here when I get back!

nodes.speaker: Miriam Prince
nodes.text: Oh no! He left! Sniff... He actually left... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait?! So that's what happened? My father always told me my mother died in a freak gold smelting accident at Fort Knox.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But really, she left him because he valued money more than her!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Your mother was the only person who ever made your Father feel joy.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: When he turned his back on her... He lost his one chance at happiness, and you lost a loving mother.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Do you understand the lesson?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, I think...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: That's good to hear. Spectral Dispatch says you have a lot of ground to cover tonight, but still... Pretty ironic, huh?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I mean, me talking and you listening for a change... Because usually it goes the other way.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Like that time you lectured me for two hours about which fork you're supposed to use to eat pastries...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Or that other time you made me balance a thesaurus on my head and recite tongue twisters about how Spain gets bad weather...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Or that other time when...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Enough already, Skazz! Just... Shut up and tell me what I'm supposed to do.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh... Mostly you're just supposed to look over there.
As Skazz points across the room, a veil parts... Revealing the Past!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm Tom Prince. I question the order of the Alphabet.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And when I buy the Dictionary, you can bet the P's will finally come first!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Look, Tom, can't you just, like, stay on topic here? You're supposed to be learning wisdom or some stuff.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And you're the ghost who's going to make me 'more smarter'?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Come on, Tom. Just look over there!
As Skazz points across the room, a veil parts... Revealing the Past!
Tom descends the stairs and enters the Dining Room...

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: What? No one is home?!

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: But Dad said there would be a Holiday Party tonight. There should be loads of people here.

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Hey! Wait a minute... This isn't even my house!

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: But why does it seem so familiar?

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: Oh wow! This is the house we used to live in back when I was a little kid.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But that doesn't make sense... My Dad had it bulldozed after we moved out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How did I get here?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: The question isn't 'where you are'... The question is 'when'...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... Skazz, is that you?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yo, Dude...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Skazz, why are you dressed up like a ghost?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Because I am the Ghost of Winter Holidays Past! OOooOOOooo!!!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That doesn't even make sense. First off, you may be 'brain dead', but that doesn't mean you aren't technically still alive...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And second, you're the exact same age as me. What would you know about Holidays past?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You dare to question the supernatur... Uh... Supernocturn... Uh... You dare question a spooky ghost?!

nodes.prompt: You dare question a spooky ghost?!

options.label: I'll hear you out... For now.
Uh... Duh! Of course, I do.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You dare question a spooky ghost?!

nodes.text: Tom pushes through a thick swash of branches and emerges at the rear of a pleasant, well-lit home!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thank goodness! Somebody help me! There's a bear after me!
Tom pounds on the windows.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Help! Heeeeelp!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: They can't hear you, Tom! You're incorporeal.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Easy... Easy...
Tom takes a step backward...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Excellent, Tom. You have uncovered a great truth.

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: The size of one's heart and the size of one's bank account have nothing to do with each other!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, I get that Spike is a good person... But are you sure there's zero correlation...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because I'm super rich. So if there was even just a fractional positive correlation, that would mean...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: No!!! There is no correlation whatsoever!!!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay... Lesson learned... Moving on.

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: No... Tom, what's the matter with you? Did you not just hear what she said?

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Mallika likes Spike because he's a `good person!` She doesn't care how much money he has! He makes her happy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Mallika likes Spike because he's a [color=#e23b3b][i]good person![/i][/color] She doesn't care how much money he has! He makes her happy!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Where'd you pick up that little gem... On a Holiday card?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Get a clue, Baloo. Mallika likes Spike because he won the Flex-Games...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That means he's `famous.` Get it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Seriously, if Skazz had won the competition, she would've totally gone after that loser, too.

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: You imbecile! Did you not just witness true happiness? How emotionally stunted are you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah... Whatever... Can we hit the next stop already. I want to check out my totally awesome future.

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAARRR!!!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: You are both of those things, and yet, Mallika chose Spike over you.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know! What's up with that? Sure, he's cool... But he's totally poor!
The Ghost Bear indicates that Tom should look through the window once more...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: See the answer for yourself, Tom.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm sorry I didn't get you a more expensive present, Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike, I think just being with you is the best Holiday gift I could've asked for.
Mallika and Spike kiss.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Happy holidays, Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You too, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Eww! They're kissing! With tongue! Why'd you make me see that?

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Because you must learn, Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So you're saying that there's a lesson here? Huh... Maybe I'm supposed to learn that Mallika likes Spike because...

nodes.prompt: Maybe I'm supposed to learn that Mallika likes Spike because...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Maybe I'm supposed to learn that Mallika likes Spike because...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Mallika knew what she was doing when she pushed me into the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You pull something like that, and there will be consequences!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And those consequences will be totally extreme, and may involve catapults or eels or seventeen grandfather clocks placed in strategic locations inside a rat-infested catacomb.

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: That's it? Nothing else?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well... Maybe I did also kind of like her... Sort of... But why didn't she like me back? I'm rich. I'm handsome... I'm rich...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I am kind of attracted to Mallika... Sort of... I mean, it's not like the poems I write her are super long or anything...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And it's not like I made her `two` CDs of original musical compositions detailing the depths of my amorous infatuation...
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's not like I made her [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] CDs of original musical compositions detailing the depths of my amorous infatuation...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Honestly, it's all just a meaningless crush.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But what I really want to know is why she doesn't like me back? I'm rich. I'm handsome... I'm rich...
While racing though the forest, Tom trips over a gnarled root. His shoe comes loose.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh oh!
Tom steps through the door and enters a dense mist...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I can't see anything! Where am I? Well, I feel a tree here, so I must be outside...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But if that was a tree, why is there shag carpet... On the wall?!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Lower!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Scratch me lower! In the small of my back!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's not shag carpet! That's fur!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Of course! What else would it be? I'm a bear!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're a bear... And you can talk?! Nyaaaahhhh!!!
Tom tears off through the woods...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Don't make me chase you, Tom! You'll make me very angry!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You can talk, and you know my `name?!` So not cool!!!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can talk, and you know my [color=#e23b3b][i]name?![/i][/color] So not cool!!!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAARRR!!!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Nyaaaahhhh!!!

rounds.subtitle: Run from the Bear! Don't trip!
Run from the Bear! Don't trip!

nodes.text: Tom Prince's voice echoes in the onrushing darkness...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm awake! And in my room! And I can hear a party downstairs!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe it all was just a dream...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Regardless, I now know exactly what I must do.
Tom eyes his catapult with resolve, and then begins his preparations...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Someone wrote 'good riddance' on my tombstone?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Who did this?! I'll show them good riddance! I'll get my revenge!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But that's the problem, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because I was selfish and vindictive and focused on revenge, I drove away everyone who ever cared about me...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh no... I suddenly feel so... Cold inside... So empty.. What is this feeling?
For the first time, the Ghost speaks... His voice is raspy, chilling...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: what you feel now... but a taste...  of what will come... after you die...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No! Spirit, please! I've learned my lesson! Take me back!
The Ghost cocks an eyebrow as if to ask, 'Uh... What'?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My grave... Look at it! It should be massive, like a skyscraper, and filled with all the super-awesome stuff I'm going to buy!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... Did I not have enough money or what?!
The Ghost wearily shakes his head from side to side.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: See, that's the problem right there! I need to amass way more money than my dad has. What was I thinking?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I must've been too focused on revenge... But what good is revenge if you're not super-rich?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, Spirit. I think I've learned my lesson. It's time to take me back.
And suddenly he is in his own Living Room once more.

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: What?! I'm home. Only... Why are there cobwebs everywhere?

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: Hey, there's somebody in that chair over there.

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: It's an Old Man... And he isn't moving...

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: I think he might be... Gulp... `Dead...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think he might be... Gulp... [color=#e23b3b][i]Dead...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Young Silas
nodes.text: Hey! Help! There's a body in here! Somebody call the police!
A menacing, deformed figure steps up behind Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh no, you're him, aren't you? You're the Ghost of Winter Holidays future!
The Ghost points to the corpse in the highback leather chair.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why are you pointing? Are you trying to tell me something?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ulp... That's me, isn't it?! That's how I die?!
The Ghost of Winter Holidays Future nods and beckons Tom forward...
Suddenly, they are walking through a shadowy graveyard.
The Ghost points once more... This time indicating a marble headstone.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's my tomb! It's...

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: { We're the ghosts of the Holiday season! {

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: { We come when the weather gets freezin'! {

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: { If you've been a miser... {

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: { We'll come make you wiser... {

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: { By scaring you 'til you see reason! {

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Happy Holidays!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: And like, don't be naughty, dude!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Or else!
We hope you enjoyed this episode!

Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: The door bursts open... A hush fills the room as Tom Prince enters...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tom, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Mallika, I've had an epiphany.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I realize that I've been a terrible person. I realize that I've been awful...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But I also realized something else. I love you desperately.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I promise to change. I promise to undo all the damage that I've done...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just please... Marry me, Mallika! Make me the happiest heir to a massive family fortune in all of Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You want me to marry you... After all the crap you pulled?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... well, let's not get ahead of ourselves. Marriage is so final. I was thinking more along the lines of 'engaged to be engaged'.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Get out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But the Ghost Bear promised me this would all work out for the best!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ghost bear?!
Later that night, Officer Monte escorts Tom from the premises...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come along, son.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I was called out of an important business meeting for this, Officer. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Mental breakdown, I'm afraid... Totally gone...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No... I love you, Mallika... Ghost bear... Egg Nog catapult...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: See what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I always knew the boy was never cut out to be a Prince.
Looks like professing your undying love isn't the way to real happiness, after all.
You're going to have to try again, and next time, remember to think like Tom Prince!
Or check out our new Premium Content, 'Football: Big Man on Campus'! Continue the story from Football and see your character in college!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: In the Graveyard, a spooky collection of spirits have assembled...

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Ahem... All together now...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard. I do try. Of course, this year Spike was a big help.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No biggie. If I didn't do it, I'm sure Mallika would've been able to find someone else to climb up the chimney and put lights on the roof.
Suddenly, the windows `explode` inward...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I don't know... But it tastes like... Nog?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's right, Mallika. I've gotten my revenge! I can finally move on!
Mallika charges out the door to find Tom Prince standing by his catapult.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tom, what do you think you're doing? You just ruined my Holiday Party!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I was getting revenge. Didn't you hear what I just said?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But it's okay now. We're cool. You pushed me into the ocean. I ruined your Holiday Party. We're square.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tom Prince, I hate you!
Mallika shoves Tom Prince backward... He flies into the icy cold swimming pool... Sploosh!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: S-s-sooo C-c-cooolldd...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Why don't you get 'square' with that, Tom?!
Tom Prince climbs out of the pool. He fixes Mallika in an icy glare.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, I w-w-will, Mallika. I will have my r-r-revenge!
What?! Mallika pushed Tom into the water, and now Tom wants revenge?
We're exactly back where we started! We know you can do better than that!
Play again, and next time, remember to think like Tom Prince!
Or check out our new Premium Content, 'Football: Big Man on Campus'! Continue the story from Football and see your character in college!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: Across town...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for throwing the Holiday party again this year, Mallika. You always do the best job with the decorations.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard. I do try. Of course, this year Spike was a big help.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No biggie. If I didn't do it, I'm sure Mallika would've been able to find someone else to climb up the chimney and put lights on the roof.
But you weren't quite perfect. Try again to get the bonus scene.
Or check out our new Premium Content, 'Football: Big Man on Campus'! Continue the story from Football and see your character in college!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: Across town...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for throwing the Holiday party again this year, Mallika. You always do the best job with the decorations.

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Son, what are you doing here? I thought I forbade you to come to this Holiday party?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, Dad, I get why you're worried.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure. You're worried that I'm going to turn out just like Mom... All soft inside...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You think my obsession with Mallika was making me a loser...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But here's the thing. You were right... I was totally wasting my time and talent on trying to get revenge.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What I should've been doing is getting rich!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Like, way richer than you! Or Great-Great-Grandpa Obadiah! Or anybody!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm going to be the richest person who ever walked the planet. And when I die, I'm going to make a giant mausoleum and take everything with me!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Tom, I appreciate your newfound enthusiasm, but right now, I'm trying to make an important sales pitch to the owner of the Centerscore Comets.

nodes.speaker: Comets' Owner
nodes.text: I don't think you have to worry about that anymore, Silas.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: What!? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Comets' Owner
nodes.text: Because your son just showed me the prototype for his new 'T-Shirt Catapult'.

nodes.speaker: Comets' Owner
nodes.text: With it, we can launch hundreds of promotional T-shirts into the crowd at one time.

nodes.speaker: Comets' Owner
nodes.text: Think of the cost-savings!

nodes.speaker: Comets' Owner
nodes.text: It's exactly this kind of retro-futuristic, turn-the-box-inside-out thinking that attracted me to Prince Industries in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: So... We have a deal then?

nodes.speaker: Comets' Owner
nodes.text: The paperwork will be sent over in the morning.

nodes.speaker: Comets' Owner
nodes.text: Now, if you'll excuse me... I think I may have overindulged on the caviar and Indonesian palm civet coffee.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Well now... You've done me proud, son.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Like I care...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I didn't do this for you. I did it for the money.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And if you want that contract with the Centerscore Comets, you're going to pay through the nose for the patent to my T-shirt catapult.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Enjoy the party, Dad!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Why you ungrateful, little...
You've done well. It looks like Tom Prince has aced his first business deal.
And he's gotten over his obsession with Mallika.
You played a great game!
Tom spins around to find the Bear lumbering toward him.
The Ghost Bear takes Tom's loose shoe into its massive jaws and eviscerates it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Noooo! That shoe is made from genuine Italian leather! Don't...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Chomp... Chomp... `Urp!`
The Ghost Bear spits a slobbery, compacted mass of leather onto the forest floor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What have you done?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The heifer that shoe was made from was fed a diet high in essential oils... Groomed by orthodox monks using platinum-hilted hide combs...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And then its pelt was brined in salt retrieved from the bottom of the Dead Sea...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: SILENCE!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Please don't eat me!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: I'm not going to eat you, Tom. I'm The Ghost Bear of Winter Holidays Present.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You... You are?

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Indeed.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, that's a relief. I...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! Wait a second, what do bears have to do with the Winter Holiday? Shouldn't you be off hibernating or something?

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAARRR!!!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Gulp... Or not...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Ahem... Now that I have your attention, look!
The Ghost Bear indicates the pleasant, well-lit home.

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: See anything familiar?

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Come, Tom Prince... Follow me... And if you try to run again, I may decide to change my mind.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Gulp!
Tom Prince follows the Ghost Bear through the woods. Eventually, they reach a pleasant, well-lit home.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait a minute! I know this place. Mallika lives here!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Indeed, and tonight, she is throwing a Winter Holiday party.

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: So... Where is your invitation, Tom?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: She sent me one... It must've... Gotten lost in the mail...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Humph!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey, it happens!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Look inside, Tom. See all the happy party-goers?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So they're having a good time. So what?

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Earlier, you were conspiring to ruin this party. Why?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because Mallika humiliated me!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: You were hurt... So you intend to hurt her back? Is that all there is?
Tom steps through the door and enters a dense mist...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I can't see anything! Where am I? Well, I feel a tree here, so I must be outside...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But if that was a tree, why is there shag carpet... On the wall?!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Lower!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Scratch me lower! In the small of my back!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's not shag carpet! That's fur!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Of course! What else would it be? I'm a bear!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're a bear... And you can talk?! Nyaaaahhhh!!!
Tom tears off through the woods...

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: Don't make me chase you, Tom! You'll make me very angry!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You can talk, and you know my `name?!` So not cool!!!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can talk, and you know my [color=#e23b3b][i]name?![/i][/color] So not cool!!!

nodes.speaker: Ghost Bear
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAARRR!!!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Nyaaaahhhh!!!

rounds.subtitle: Run from the Bear! Don't trip!
Run from the Bear! Don't trip!

nodes.text: Across town...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for throwing the Holiday party again this year, Mallika. You always do the best job with the decorations.
Across town...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for throwing the Holiday party again this year, Mallika. You always do the best job with the decorations.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard. I do try. Of course, this year Spike was a big help.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No biggie. If I didn't do it, I'm sure Mallika would've been able to find someone else to climb up the chimney and put lights on the roof.
In the Graveyard, a spooky collection of spirits have assembled...

nodes.speaker: Obadiah
nodes.text: Ahem... All together now...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Mallika and her lousy friends may have gotten the better of me at the Concert, the Flex Games, and even at the Prince Prix...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But tonight, I will have my revenge!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: When this catapult I've designed is finished, I'll use it to egg Mallika's Holiday Party with gallons of gooey Holiday Nog!

nodes.text: Their holiday will be ruined!

Now, we're well aware that Tom Prince's schemes aren't exactly in keeping with the Spirit of the Holiday Season...
But then again, Tom Prince isn't exactly the nicest guy, either.

nodes.text: Now then, where were we?

nodes.speaker: Tom
